docs.title: Notice: Parking garage maintenance
docs.body:
To all Harbor Plaza tenants:

The north parking garage will be closed from Saturday, May 11, through Sunday, May 12, while the surface is resealed. During this time, tenants may park in the south garage at no charge. Please show your tenant badge to the attendant at the entrance.

Vehicles left in the north garage after 7 p.m. on Friday will be moved at the owner's expense. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation.

Harbor Plaza Building Management

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the notice?
choices: To announce a temporary garage closure
To introduce new parking fees
To report damage to tenants' vehicles
To advertise a new parking garage

evidence.quote: The north parking garage will be closed from Saturday, May 11, through Sunday, May 12

explain.en: The notice tells tenants that the north garage will be closed for two days and explains where to park instead. It does not mention new fees, damage or a new garage.
explain.th: ประกาศนี้แจ้งผู้เช่าว่าที่จอดรถฝั่งเหนือจะปิดสองวัน และบอกว่าให้ไปจอดที่ไหนแทน จึงเป็นการประกาศปิดที่จอดรถชั่วคราว ไม่ได้พูดถึงค่าจอดใหม่ ความเสียหายของรถ หรือที่จอดรถแห่งใหม่

questions.prompt: What should tenants do to park in the south garage?
choices: Show a tenant badge at the entrance
Pay a small fee to the attendant
Register online before Friday
Leave their keys with building management

evidence.quote: Please show your tenant badge to the attendant at the entrance.

explain.en: The notice asks tenants to show their tenant badge to the attendant. Parking there is free ('at no charge'), so paying a fee is wrong.
explain.th: ประกาศขอให้ผู้เช่าแสดงบัตรผู้เช่า (tenant badge) กับพนักงานที่ทางเข้า และการจอดที่ฝั่งใต้ไม่เสียค่าใช้จ่าย (at no charge) จึงไม่ต้องจ่ายเงิน

questions.prompt: What will most likely happen to a car left in the north garage on Saturday morning?
choices: It will be moved, and the owner will pay the cost
It will be resealed together with the surface
It will be given a free parking pass
It will be parked by the attendant in the south garage for free

evidence.quote: Vehicles left in the north garage after 7 p.m. on Friday will be moved at the owner's expense.

explain.en: Any vehicle still there after 7 p.m. on Friday will be moved 'at the owner's expense', meaning the owner pays. A car there on Saturday morning falls into that group.
explain.th: รถที่ยังจอดอยู่หลัง 1 ทุ่มวันศุกร์จะถูกย้าย โดยเจ้าของต้องเสียค่าใช้จ่ายเอง (at the owner's expense) รถที่ยังอยู่เช้าวันเสาร์จึงจะถูกย้ายและเจ้าของต้องจ่าย

docs.title: Chat: Presentation morning
docs.body:
Ana Ruiz (9:02 A.M.): Tom, are you at the office yet? The client presentation starts at 10.
Tom Becker (9:04 A.M.): Not yet. My train was delayed, so I'll get in around 9:40.
Ana Ruiz (9:05 A.M.): Okay. The handouts are still in the print room. Could you bring the projector cable from your desk?
Tom Becker (9:06 A.M.): Sure, it's in my top drawer. Mei can get it for you.
Ana Ruiz (9:07 A.M.): Good idea. Could you also stop for coffee for the clients on your way in?
Tom Becker (9:08 A.M.): I'm cutting it close as it is.
Ana Ruiz (9:09 A.M.): Understood. I'll ask Mei to order it instead.

questions.prompt: At 9:08 A.M., what does Mr. Becker most likely mean when he writes, "I'm cutting it close as it is."?
choices: He plans to shorten the presentation
He might arrive late if he makes another stop
He thinks the coffee is too expensive
He has already bought the coffee

evidence.quote: Could you also stop for coffee for the clients on your way in?

explain.en: Ms. Ruiz asks him to stop for coffee, and he answers that he is already close to being late. Ms. Ruiz then offers another solution, which confirms that he cannot spare the time.
explain.th: แอนาขอให้ทอมแวะซื้อกาแฟ แต่ทอมตอบว่า "I'm cutting it close" แปลว่าเวลาเขาแทบไม่เหลืออยู่แล้ว ถ้าแวะอีกอาจไปสาย แอนาจึงเปลี่ยนไปให้เหม่ยสั่งกาแฟแทน

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Becker say about the projector cable?
choices: It is already in the conference room
It was left in the print room
It is in the top drawer of his desk
It needs to be bought on the way

evidence.quote: Sure, it's in my top drawer.

explain.en: Mr. Becker says "it's in my top drawer" in reply to the request for the cable. The print room is where the handouts are, not the cable.
explain.th: ทอมตอบว่าสายโปรเจกเตอร์อยู่ในลิ้นชักบนสุดของโต๊ะเขา (it's in my top drawer) ส่วนห้องพิมพ์เอกสารเป็นที่เก็บเอกสารแจก ไม่ใช่ที่เก็บสายนี้

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Ms. Ruiz?
choices: She is already at the office
She is traveling on the same train as Mr. Becker
She will not attend the presentation
She works for the client

evidence.quote: Tom, are you at the office yet?
The handouts are still in the print room.

explain.en: Ms. Ruiz asks whether Mr. Becker is at the office "yet" and says the handouts are in the print room, so she is already there. Nothing suggests she is on his train.
explain.th: แอนาถามทอมว่า "at the office yet?" และพูดถึงเอกสารในห้องพิมพ์ แสดงว่าเธออยู่ที่ออฟฟิศแล้ว ไม่มีข้อความใดบอกว่าเธอนั่งรถไฟขบวนเดียวกับทอม

docs.title: Email: Welcome to Corvane Logistics
docs.body:
To: Kevin Lau
From: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Your first week at Corvane Logistics

Dear Mr. Lau,

Welcome to Corvane Logistics! Your orientation will take place on Monday, June 3, at 8:30 a.m. in the Training Room on the second floor. Please bring a photo ID and your signed tax forms so that we can complete your employment file.

After the morning session, you will tour the warehouse with your supervisor, Ms. Okafor, and have lunch with your team. Parking passes will be issued at the front desk. Should you have any questions before you start, please do not hesitate to contact me at extension 214.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield
Human Resources

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To explain what a new employee should expect on his first day
To ask Mr. Lau to sign an employment contract
To announce a change in warehouse procedures
To invite Mr. Lau to a team lunch next month

evidence.quote: Your orientation will take place on Monday, June 3, at 8:30 a.m.

explain.en: The email gives the orientation time, place, items to bring and the day's plan for a new hire. The lunch is only one part of that plan, and no contract is mentioned.
explain.th: อีเมลบอกเวลา สถานที่ สิ่งที่ต้องนำมา และกำหนดการของวันแรกสำหรับพนักงานใหม่ จึงเป็นการแจ้งรายละเอียดวันแรกของการทำงาน มื้อกลางวันเป็นเพียงส่วนหนึ่ง และไม่มีการพูดถึงสัญญาจ้าง

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Lau asked to bring to orientation?
choices: A parking pass and a photo ID
A photo ID and signed tax forms
A copy of his résumé
Lunch for his team

evidence.quote: Please bring a photo ID and your signed tax forms

explain.en: The first paragraph asks for a photo ID and signed tax forms. Parking passes will be given to him at the front desk, so he does not bring one.
explain.th: ย่อหน้าแรกขอให้นำบัตรประจำตัวที่มีรูปถ่าย (photo ID) และแบบฟอร์มภาษีที่เซ็นแล้วมา ส่วนบัตรจอดรถ (parking pass) บริษัทจะออกให้ที่เคาน์เตอร์ด้านหน้า ไม่ต้องนำมาเอง

questions.prompt: The word "complete" in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to
choices: total
improve
replace
finish

evidence.quote: so that we can complete your employment file

explain.en: Here "complete" is a verb meaning to finish preparing the file. "Total" is a tempting adjective meaning, but it does not fit the sentence.
explain.th: ในประโยคนี้ complete เป็นกริยา แปลว่า ทำให้เสร็จสมบูรณ์ (finish) คือทำแฟ้มข้อมูลพนักงานให้ครบ ส่วน total เป็นคำที่ดูใกล้เคียงแต่ไม่เหมาะกับโครงสร้างประโยค

docs.title: Notice: Pool schedule changes
docs.body:
Brightwater Community Center will change the hours of its indoor pool beginning Monday, September 2. The pool will open at 6 a.m. instead of 7 a.m. on weekdays to give early-morning swimmers more time before work. On weekends, the pool will remain open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.

The pool will be closed every Wednesday from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. for water-quality testing. Swim lessons for children will continue as scheduled on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. Members who wish to reserve a lane should call the front desk at least one day in advance.

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to seeing you at the pool.

Brightwater Community Center Staff

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the notice?
choices: To announce the opening of a new community center
To promote swim lessons for children
To inform members of changes to the pool schedule
To ask members to help test the water

evidence.quote: Brightwater Community Center will change the hours of its indoor pool beginning Monday, September 2.

explain.en: The notice opens by saying the pool hours will change and then lists the new times. Swim lessons are mentioned only as continuing as before.
explain.th: ประกาศเริ่มด้วยการบอกว่าเวลาเปิดสระจะเปลี่ยน แล้วระบุเวลาใหม่ จึงเป็นการแจ้งการเปลี่ยนตารางสระว่ายน้ำ ส่วนคลาสเรียนว่ายน้ำของเด็กถูกกล่าวถึงแค่ว่าจะจัดตามเดิม

questions.prompt: What is NOT indicated about the pool?
choices: It will open earlier on weekdays
Children's swim lessons will be canceled
It will close for testing on Wednesday afternoons
Lanes can be reserved by phone

evidence.quote: Swim lessons for children will continue as scheduled on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons.

explain.en: The notice says children's lessons "will continue as scheduled," so canceling them is the false statement. The other three points are all stated.
explain.th: ประกาศบอกว่าคลาสว่ายน้ำของเด็กจะ "continue as scheduled" คือจัดต่อตามปกติ ข้อที่ว่ายกเลิกจึงไม่จริง ส่วนข้ออื่นอีกสามข้อมีระบุไว้ในประกาศทั้งหมด

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the weekend schedule?
choices: The pool will open at 6 a.m.
The pool will close for testing
Lane reservations will not be accepted
It will stay the same

evidence.quote: On weekends, the pool will remain open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.

explain.en: The phrase "will remain open" implies the weekend hours are not changing; only weekday opening time is moved earlier.
explain.th: คำว่า "will remain open" บอกเป็นนัยว่าเวลาเปิดวันเสาร์-อาทิตย์ไม่เปลี่ยน มีเฉพาะเวลาเปิดวันธรรมดาที่เลื่อนให้เร็วขึ้น

docs.title: Chat: Late chair shipment
docs.body:
Priya Nair (2:15 P.M.): Luis, the Hartman order is supposed to ship today, but I only see 40 of the 60 chairs in the warehouse system.
Luis Ortega (2:17 P.M.): The other chairs arrived this morning. They're still on the dock.
Priya Nair (2:18 P.M.): Can your team scan them in before 4? The truck leaves at 4:30.
Luis Ortega (2:20 P.M.): That's tight, but we can try. Two of the crew are out sick today.
Priya Nair (2:21 P.M.): I could send Hana over to help.
Luis Ortega (2:22 P.M.): That would be a lifesaver.
Priya Nair (2:23 P.M.): She'll be there in ten minutes.

questions.prompt: How many chairs are missing from the warehouse system?

evidence.quote: I only see 40 of the 60 chairs in the warehouse system

explain.en: Ms. Nair sees 40 of the 60 chairs in the system, so 20 are missing. Forty is the number she can see, which makes it the tempting wrong answer.
explain.th: ปริยาเห็นเก้าอี้ในระบบ 40 ตัวจากทั้งหมด 60 ตัว จึงยังขาดอีก 20 ตัว เลข 40 คือจำนวนที่เห็นในระบบแล้ว ไม่ใช่จำนวนที่ขาด

questions.prompt: At 2:20 P.M., what does Mr. Ortega most likely mean when he writes, "That's tight"?
choices: The truck has too little space
The chairs are packed too closely
The deadline will be hard to meet
The budget for the order is limited

evidence.quote: Can your team scan them in before 4? The truck leaves at 4:30.

explain.en: She asks for the chairs to be scanned in before 4, and he adds that two workers are out sick. "Tight" therefore refers to the limited time and staff, not to space or money.
explain.th: ปริยาขอให้สแกนเก้าอี้ให้เสร็จก่อน 4 โมง และลูอิสบอกว่าลูกทีมป่วยไปสองคน "That's tight" จึงหมายถึงเวลาและคนที่จำกัด ทำให้ทำตามกำหนดได้ยาก ไม่ได้หมายถึงพื้นที่หรืองบประมาณ

questions.prompt: At 2:22 P.M., what does Mr. Ortega most likely mean when he writes, "That would be a lifesaver"?
choices: He would be very grateful for the extra help
He is worried about a safety problem
He wants Hana to take the sick workers home
He plans to cancel the shipment

evidence.quote: I could send Hana over to help.

explain.en: He is replying to the offer to send Hana, and the idiom expresses strong relief and thanks. Nothing in the chat concerns safety or canceling.
explain.th: ลูอิสตอบข้อเสนอของปริยาที่จะส่งฮานะมาช่วย สำนวน "a lifesaver" แปลว่าช่วยได้มาก เขาจึงขอบคุณและโล่งใจกับความช่วยเหลือเพิ่ม ไม่เกี่ยวกับเรื่องความปลอดภัยหรือการยกเลิก

docs.title: Ad: Lakeside Bike Rentals
docs.body:
Explore the shoreline on two wheels! Lakeside Bike Rentals offers daily and weekly rentals of city, mountain, and electric bicycles. Every rental includes a helmet, a lock, and a map of the 12-mile lake trail.

Rates start at $15 per day for city bikes and $30 per day for electric bikes. Rent for five days or more and receive 10 percent off your total. Guided group tours leave at 9 a.m. every Saturday and must be booked at least two days ahead.

Open daily from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. at 40 Pier Road, next to the ferry terminal. Mention this ad to get a free water bottle with your first rental.

questions.prompt: What is included with every rental?
choices: A water bottle and a helmet
A guided group tour
A repair kit and a lock
A helmet, a lock, and a trail map

evidence.quote: Every rental includes a helmet, a lock, and a map of the 12-mile lake trail.

explain.en: The first paragraph lists a helmet, a lock, and a trail map. The water bottle is only for customers who mention the ad.
explain.th: ย่อหน้าแรกระบุว่าทุกการเช่ารวมหมวกกันน็อก กุญแจล็อก และแผนที่เส้นทางรอบทะเลสาบ ส่วนขวดน้ำฟรีให้เฉพาะลูกค้าที่บอกว่าเห็นโฆษณานี้

questions.prompt: What is NOT stated about the shop?
choices: It rents electric bicycles
It is located near a ferry terminal
It is closed on weekends
It offers a discount for longer rentals

evidence.quote: Open daily from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

explain.en: The shop is "open daily," and tours even run on Saturday, so a weekend closure is false. The other statements appear in the ad.
explain.th: ร้านเปิดทุกวัน (open daily) และยังมีทัวร์วันเสาร์ด้วย ข้อที่ว่าปิดวันหยุดสุดสัปดาห์จึงไม่จริง ส่วนข้ออื่นมีระบุไว้ในโฆษณา

questions.prompt: The word "leave" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
choices: abandon
depart
allow
remain

evidence.quote: Guided group tours leave at 9 a.m. every Saturday

explain.en: Tours "leave" at a set time means they depart. "Abandon" is another meaning of leave but does not fit a schedule.
explain.th: tours leave at 9 a.m. หมายถึงทัวร์ออกเดินทางตอน 9 โมง จึงใกล้เคียงกับ depart ส่วน abandon (ทิ้ง) เป็นความหมายอื่นของ leave ที่ไม่เข้ากับกำหนดการ

docs.title: Article: Greenfield Market Moves Downtown
docs.body:
GREENFIELD (March 4) - The Greenfield Farmers Market will relocate to Central Square this spring after nearly 20 years in the Millbrook parking lot. [1] City officials announced the move on Monday, saying the new location is easier to reach by bus and bicycle.

The market will open on April 6 and run every Saturday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. through October. Organizers expect about 60 vendors, up from 45 last year. [2] Several new vendors will sell prepared foods, which were not allowed at the old site. [3]

"We have wanted to move for years," said market manager Joan Pelletier. "Our customers kept telling us the old lot was too far from the center of town." [4] Parking will be limited near the square, so shoppers are encouraged to use the free shuttle from the library.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
choices: A new bus route to the library
The closing of a parking lot
An increase in vendor fees
The relocation of a farmers market

evidence.quote: The Greenfield Farmers Market will relocate to Central Square this spring

explain.en: Every paragraph concerns the market's move to Central Square and what changes with it. The bus, shuttle and parking details are supporting information.
explain.th: ทุกย่อหน้าพูดถึงการย้ายตลาดนัดเกษตรกรไปที่ Central Square และสิ่งที่เปลี่ยนไป ส่วนเรื่องรถบัส รถรับส่ง และที่จอดรถเป็นรายละเอียดประกอบ

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "That would be the largest number of vendors in the market's history."

evidence.quote: Organizers expect about 60 vendors, up from 45 last year.

explain.en: "That" refers to the vendor total of about 60, which appears in the sentence just before position [2]. The other positions follow sentences about the move, prepared foods or parking.
explain.th: คำว่า "That" หมายถึงจำนวนผู้ขายประมาณ 60 ราย ซึ่งอยู่ในประโยคก่อนตำแหน่ง [2] พอดี ตำแหน่งอื่นอยู่หลังประโยคเกี่ยวกับการย้ายตลาด อาหารปรุงสำเร็จ หรือที่จอดรถ

questions.prompt: The word "run" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
choices: operate
jog
manage
flow

evidence.quote: run every Saturday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. through October

explain.en: A market that will "run" every Saturday is one that operates on those days. "Manage" is tempting but would need a person as its subject.
explain.th: ตลาดที่ "run" ทุกวันเสาร์หมายถึงเปิดดำเนินการ (operate) ในวันนั้น ส่วน manage ดูใกล้เคียงแต่ต้องมีคนเป็นประธานของประโยค

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the Millbrook parking lot?
choices: It will be sold to a developer
It had a free shuttle service
It was inconvenient for some shoppers
It was open only in summer

evidence.quote: the old lot was too far from the center of town

explain.en: Ms. Pelletier says customers complained that the old lot was too far from the town center. The shuttle serves the new site, not the old one.
explain.th: ผู้จัดการตลาดบอกว่าลูกค้าบ่นว่าลานจอดรถเดิมไกลจากใจกลางเมืองเกินไป จึงสรุปได้ว่าไม่สะดวกสำหรับลูกค้าบางคน ส่วนรถรับส่งฟรีให้บริการที่สถานที่ใหม่

docs.title: Form: Expense Reimbursement Request
docs.body:
Employee name: Rosa Delgado
Department: Sales
Date submitted: November 12
Trip: Client visit, Denver (November 5-7)

Expenses:
Airfare (round trip): $286.40 - receipt attached
Hotel (2 nights): $210.00 - receipt attached
Taxi to airport: $34.00 - no receipt available
Meals: $0.00 (covered by client)

Notes: Per company policy, expenses without receipts must be approved by a department manager. Please send payment to my direct deposit account.

Manager approval: Pending

questions.prompt: Why might Ms. Delgado's request require extra approval?
choices: One expense does not have a receipt
She submitted the form late
She stayed more than two nights
Her meals were paid for by the company

evidence.quote: Taxi to airport: $34.00 - no receipt available
expenses without receipts must be approved by a department manager

explain.en: The taxi fare has no receipt, and company policy says such expenses need a manager's approval. The form does not say it was submitted late.
explain.th: ค่าแท็กซี่ไม่มีใบเสร็จ และนโยบายบริษัทกำหนดว่ารายจ่ายที่ไม่มีใบเสร็จต้องได้รับอนุมัติจากผู้จัดการแผนก จึงต้องมีการอนุมัติเพิ่ม ส่วนในแบบฟอร์มไม่ได้บอกว่าส่งช้า

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned about Ms. Delgado's trip?
choices: She visited a client
Her manager has approved all of the costs
She stayed two nights at a hotel
Her meals were covered by the client

evidence.quote: Manager approval: Pending

explain.en: The form lists manager approval as "Pending," so the costs have not been approved yet. The client visit, two hotel nights and client-paid meals are all listed.
explain.th: ช่องการอนุมัติของผู้จัดการระบุว่า "Pending" คือยังรออยู่ ข้อที่ว่าอนุมัติแล้วจึงไม่จริง ส่วนการพบลูกค้า พักโรงแรมสองคืน และลูกค้าจ่ายค่าอาหารมีระบุไว้ครบ

docs.title: Schedule: Riverside Business Forum, Friday, October 18
docs.body:
8:30 a.m. Registration and breakfast (Main Lobby)
9:15 a.m. Opening remarks: Elena Marsh, Forum Director (Hall A)
9:45 a.m. Workshop: Writing Clear Reports - Leo Tanaka (Room 204)
11:00 a.m. Panel: The Future of Remote Work - four guest speakers (Hall A)
12:15 p.m. Networking lunch (Garden Terrace)
1:30 p.m. Workshop: Negotiation Skills - Hye-jin Park (Room 204)
3:00 p.m. Closing session and prize drawing (Hall A)

Note: Workshops are limited to 30 participants. Sign up at the registration desk. Lunch is included with registration; vegetarian meals are available on request.

questions.prompt: Where will the panel discussion take place?
choices: Hall A
Room 204
Garden Terrace
Main Lobby

evidence.quote: Panel: The Future of Remote Work - four guest speakers (Hall A)

explain.en: The 11:00 a.m. panel is listed with Hall A. Room 204 is where the workshops are held.
explain.th: การเสวนา (panel) เวลา 11:00 น. จัดที่ Hall A ส่วน Room 204 เป็นห้องสำหรับเวิร์กช็อป

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the Negotiation Skills workshop?
choices: It is led by the Forum Director
It takes place before lunch
It may not have room for everyone who wants to attend
It is held in Hall A

evidence.quote: Workshops are limited to 30 participants.

explain.en: Because workshops are limited to 30 people and require sign-up, some attendees could be turned away. It is led by Ms. Park, in Room 204, after lunch.
explain.th: เวิร์กช็อปจำกัด 30 คนและต้องลงชื่อล่วงหน้า จึงอาจมีผู้สนใจบางคนไม่ได้ที่นั่ง ส่วนวิทยากรคือคุณพาร์ก จัดที่ห้อง 204 หลังมื้อกลางวัน

questions.prompt: What is NOT stated about the forum?
choices: Lunch is included with registration
Two workshops are held in the same room
Vegetarian meals cost extra
The day ends with a prize drawing

evidence.quote: vegetarian meals are available on request

explain.en: The schedule says only that vegetarian meals are available on request and never mentions an extra charge. Lunch inclusion, Room 204 for both workshops and the closing drawing are all stated.
explain.th: ตารางบอกเพียงว่ามีอาหารมังสวิรัติตามคำขอ (available on request) ไม่ได้พูดถึงค่าใช้จ่ายเพิ่ม ส่วนมื้อกลางวันรวมในค่าลงทะเบียน เวิร์กช็อปสองรอบใช้ห้อง 204 เหมือนกัน และปิดงานด้วยการจับรางวัล

docs.title: Review: Harbor Light Inn
docs.body:
Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
Posted by Marcus T., June 20

My wife and I spent three nights at the Harbor Light Inn during our anniversary trip, and we would gladly return. [1] The room was spotless, and the view of the bay from our balcony was spectacular. The staff greeted us by name and recommended several local restaurants within walking distance. [2]

There were a few drawbacks. The Wi-Fi was unreliable in the evenings, and breakfast, though tasty, ended at 9:30, which was too early for us. [3] When we mentioned this at the front desk, the manager apologized and offered us a late checkout at no charge. [4] Overall, the inn offers excellent value for the price, and I recommend it to anyone visiting the coast.

questions.prompt: Why did Marcus write the review?
choices: To complain about an incorrect bill
To request a refund from the manager
To compare two hotels on the coast
To describe his stay and recommend the inn

evidence.quote: Overall, the inn offers excellent value for the price, and I recommend it to anyone visiting the coast.

explain.en: He describes both good points and problems of his stay and ends by recommending the inn. He received a free late checkout rather than asking for a refund.
explain.th: มาร์คัสเล่าทั้งข้อดีและข้อเสียของการพักแล้วสรุปแนะนำโรงแรมนี้ เขาได้เลทเช็กเอาต์ฟรีจากผู้จัดการ ไม่ได้ขอเงินคืนหรือร้องเรื่องบิล

questions.prompt: What problem did Marcus have with breakfast?
choices: It ended too early for him
It was not tasty
It was not included in the room price
It was served only on the balcony

evidence.quote: breakfast, though tasty, ended at 9:30, which was too early for us

explain.en: The review says breakfast was tasty but ended at 9:30, too early for the couple. Taste was praised, so it is not the problem.
explain.th: รีวิวบอกว่าอาหารเช้าอร่อย แต่เลิกเสิร์ฟตอน 9:30 ซึ่งเร็วเกินไปสำหรับพวกเขา (too early for us) รสชาติจึงไม่ใช่ปัญหา

questions.prompt: The word "drawbacks" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
choices: rewards
disadvantages
journeys
expenses

evidence.quote: There were a few drawbacks.

explain.en: The paragraph goes on to list Wi-Fi and breakfast problems, so "drawbacks" means disadvantages. "Expenses" might tempt readers who see the word "price" later.
explain.th: ย่อหน้านี้ตามด้วยปัญหาเรื่อง Wi-Fi และเวลาอาหารเช้า drawbacks จึงหมายถึงข้อเสีย (disadvantages) ส่วน expenses (ค่าใช้จ่าย) ไม่เข้ากับบริบท

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "His quick response made up for the inconvenience."

evidence.quote: the manager apologized and offered us a late checkout at no charge.

explain.en: "His" refers to the manager, who is introduced just before position [4], and his apology and offer are the quick response. No manager appears before the other positions.
explain.th: คำว่า "His" หมายถึงผู้จัดการ ซึ่งเพิ่งถูกกล่าวถึงก่อนตำแหน่ง [4] การขอโทษและเสนอเลทเช็กเอาต์คือการตอบสนองที่รวดเร็ว ตำแหน่งอื่นยังไม่มีการพูดถึงผู้จัดการ

docs.title: Email: Catering order change
docs.body:
To: Marcus Webb
From: Lena Ortiz, Brightside Catering
Date: June 3
Subject: Your order for the staff luncheon

Dear Mr. Webb,

Thank you for your order of 40 box lunches for your company's staff luncheon on Friday, June 14. Unfortunately, our supplier cannot deliver the grilled salmon we planned to serve. We would like to replace it with roasted chicken at the same price. If you prefer to keep the salmon, we can offer it on a later date, but not on June 14.

Please reply by Thursday, June 6, to confirm the change. After that date, we cannot guarantee that the chicken will be available. Vegetarian meals are not affected by this change.

Sincerely,
Lena Ortiz
Brightside Catering

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Ortiz write the email?
choices: To ask for a larger order
To propose replacing a menu item
To change the delivery address
To announce a price increase

evidence.quote: our supplier cannot deliver the grilled salmon we planned to serve
We would like to replace it with roasted chicken at the same price.

explain.en: The supplier cannot deliver the salmon, so Ms. Ortiz proposes roasted chicken at the same price. The price stays the same, so an increase is wrong.
explain.th: ผู้จัดเลี้ยงแจ้งว่าซัพพลายเออร์ส่งปลาแซลมอนไม่ได้ จึงเสนอเปลี่ยนเป็นไก่อบ (replace it with roasted chicken) ในราคาเดิม ไม่ได้ขึ้นราคา จึงเป็นการเสนอเปลี่ยนเมนู

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Ortiz ask Mr. Webb to do by June 6?
choices: Pay a deposit
Choose vegetarian meals
Reduce the number of lunches
Reply to confirm the change

evidence.quote: Please reply by Thursday, June 6, to confirm the change.

explain.en: The email asks him to reply by June 6 to confirm the change. Vegetarian meals are mentioned only to say they are not affected.
explain.th: อีเมลขอให้ตอบกลับภายในวันที่ 6 มิถุนายนเพื่อยืนยันการเปลี่ยนเมนู (reply ... to confirm the change) ส่วนอาหารมังสวิรัติถูกกล่าวถึงเพียงว่าไม่ได้รับผลกระทบ

questions.prompt: What is NOT indicated about the order?
choices: It includes 40 box lunches.
It is for an event on June 14.
The vegetarian meals will be changed.
The chicken costs the same as the salmon.

evidence.quote: Vegetarian meals are not affected by this change.

explain.en: The email says vegetarian meals are not affected, so they will not be changed. The other three details are all stated directly.
explain.th: อีเมลบอกว่าอาหารมังสวิรัติไม่ได้รับผลกระทบ (not affected) จึงไม่ถูกเปลี่ยน ส่วนอีกสามข้อมีระบุไว้ตรง ๆ ในอีเมล

docs.title: Chat: Delayed shipment
docs.body:
Priya Nair (10:14 A.M.): Hi Tom, did the display shelves for the Westfield store arrive yet?
Tom Becker (10:16 A.M.): Not yet. The carrier says they are stuck at a distribution center because of a computer problem.
Priya Nair (10:17 A.M.): The grand opening is Saturday. We can't open with empty walls.
Tom Becker (10:19 A.M.): I know. I can drive over to the Dunmore warehouse and pick up the spare shelves there. It's about a two-hour trip.
Priya Nair (10:20 A.M.): That would be great. I'll let the store manager know to expect you around 2 P.M.
Tom Becker (10:21 A.M.): Better make it 3. I need to sign out a van first.
Priya Nair (10:22 A.M.): Got it.

questions.prompt: At 10:17 A.M., what does Ms. Nair most likely mean when she writes, "We can't open with empty walls"?
choices: The store walls still need to be painted.
The shelves are needed before the grand opening.
The store should open later than planned.
The shipment contains the wrong shelves.

evidence.quote: The grand opening is Saturday. We can't open with empty walls.

explain.en: Right after mentioning the Saturday grand opening, she says the store cannot open with empty walls, meaning the missing shelves must be in place by then. Nothing is said about painting or wrong shelves.
explain.th: คุณ Nair พูดต่อจากเรื่องวันเปิดร้านวันเสาร์ ว่าเปิดร้านโดยผนังว่างเปล่าไม่ได้ (empty walls) หมายถึงต้องมีชั้นวางของให้ทันก่อนงานเปิดร้าน ไม่ได้พูดถึงการทาสีหรือชั้นผิดแบบ

questions.prompt: Why will Mr. Becker go to the Dunmore warehouse?
choices: To meet with the carrier
To return damaged shelves
To collect backup shelves
To sign out a van

evidence.quote: I can drive over to the Dunmore warehouse and pick up the spare shelves there.

explain.en: He plans to pick up the spare shelves there. Signing out a van is something he must do first, not the reason for the trip.
explain.th: คุณ Becker จะขับไปรับชั้นวางสำรอง (spare shelves) ที่คลังสินค้า Dunmore ส่วนการเบิกรถตู้เป็นสิ่งที่ต้องทำก่อน ไม่ใช่เหตุผลของการเดินทาง

questions.prompt: When will Mr. Becker most likely arrive at the Westfield store?
choices: Around noon
Around 2 P.M.
Around 3 P.M.
Around 5 P.M.

evidence.quote: Better make it 3. I need to sign out a van first.

explain.en: Ms. Nair first says 2 P.M., but Mr. Becker corrects it to 3 because he must sign out a van first. The earlier time was only her first estimate.
explain.th: คุณ Nair บอกว่าจะแจ้งผู้จัดการว่าราว 2 โมง แต่คุณ Becker ขอเลื่อนเป็น 3 โมง (Better make it 3) เพราะต้องเบิกรถตู้ก่อน เวลา 2 โมงเป็นแค่เวลาที่เธอประมาณไว้แรกเริ่ม

docs.title: Chat: Planning the client dinner
docs.body:
Dana Kim (4:02 P.M.): Quick update on Thursday's client dinner. Hartley Grill can seat us at 7:00, but only for eight people.
Omar Reyes (4:04 P.M.): We have ten confirmed. Two of the guests are from the Seoul office.
Elise Moreau (4:05 P.M.): Could we move to Cafe Lumen? I used it last spring, and they have a private room.
Dana Kim (4:07 P.M.): Good idea. Omar, can you call them?
Omar Reyes (4:08 P.M.): Sure. Do we know their prices?
Elise Moreau (4:09 P.M.): About $45 per person, including dessert.
Jack Turner (4:11 P.M.): That's within the budget Ms. Park approved. I'll email the guests the new location once Omar confirms.
Omar Reyes (4:12 P.M.): I'll call now.

questions.prompt: At 4:04 P.M., what does Mr. Reyes most likely mean when he writes, "We have ten confirmed"?
choices: The restaurant is fully booked.
Eight seats will not be enough.
Two guests have canceled.
The dinner should be held at the Seoul office.

evidence.quote: Hartley Grill can seat us at 7:00, but only for eight people.
We have ten confirmed.

explain.en: Ms. Kim says the restaurant can seat only eight, and Mr. Reyes replies that ten guests are confirmed, so the table is too small. The Seoul office is mentioned only as where two guests work.
explain.th: คุณ Kim บอกว่าร้านรับได้แค่ 8 คน คุณ Reyes จึงตอบว่ามีผู้ยืนยันแล้ว 10 คน (We have ten confirmed) หมายความว่าที่นั่ง 8 ที่ไม่พอ ส่วนสำนักงานโซลถูกกล่าวถึงแค่เป็นที่ทำงานของแขกสองคน

questions.prompt: Why does Ms. Moreau suggest Cafe Lumen?
choices: It is cheaper than Hartley Grill.
It is near the Seoul office.
It has a private room.
It can seat guests earlier.

evidence.quote: they have a private room

explain.en: She says she used it last spring and that it has a private room. The chat never compares its price with Hartley Grill.
explain.th: คุณ Moreau เคยใช้ร้านนี้เมื่อฤดูใบไม้ผลิที่แล้วและบอกว่ามีห้องส่วนตัว (a private room) แชทไม่ได้เปรียบเทียบราคากับ Hartley Grill

questions.prompt: The word "approved" in Mr. Turner's 4:11 P.M. message is closest in meaning to
choices: authorized
reviewed
requested
reduced

evidence.quote: That's within the budget Ms. Park approved.

explain.en: A budget that Ms. Park approved is one she authorized or officially accepted. She did not merely review, request or reduce it.
explain.th: budget ที่คุณ Park approved หมายถึงเธออนุมัติ (authorized) งบประมาณนั้นแล้ว ไม่ใช่แค่ตรวจดู ขอ หรือลดงบ

docs.title: Letter: Membership renewal
docs.body:
Greenfield Public Library
42 Alder Street, Greenfield

April 8

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

Your Greenfield Library Friends membership will expire on April 30. Renewing helps us fund children's reading programs and keep our collection up to date. As a member, you receive free admission to author events and a 15 percent discount at the library cafe.

To renew, return the enclosed form with your payment of $30 by April 25, or visit our Web site. Members who renew before the deadline will receive a canvas tote bag as a thank-you gift. Please note that we are unable to extend memberships once they expire.

We hope you will continue to be part of our community.

Sincerely,
Helen Cho
Membership Coordinator

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the letter?
choices: To invite Ms. Alvarez to an author event
To remind a member to renew her membership
To thank a donor for a gift
To announce a change in library hours

evidence.quote: Your Greenfield Library Friends membership will expire on April 30.

explain.en: The letter opens by saying her membership will expire and then explains how to renew. The author events are only a member benefit.
explain.th: จดหมายเริ่มด้วยการแจ้งว่าสมาชิกภาพของคุณ Alvarez จะหมดอายุ (will expire) แล้วอธิบายวิธีต่ออายุ งานพบนักเขียนเป็นเพียงสิทธิประโยชน์ของสมาชิก

questions.prompt: The word "extend" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
choices: prolong
enlarge
reach
spread

evidence.quote: we are unable to extend memberships once they expire

explain.en: To extend a membership means to make it last longer, which is what prolong means. Enlarge and spread suggest size, not time.
explain.th: extend a membership คือทำให้สมาชิกภาพยาวขึ้น ตรงกับ prolong ส่วน enlarge และ spread เกี่ยวกับขนาดหรือการกระจาย ไม่เกี่ยวกับเวลา

questions.prompt: What is suggested about members who renew after April 25?
choices: They will lose the cafe discount immediately.
They must pay a higher fee.
They will not receive the thank-you gift.
They cannot renew online.

evidence.quote: Members who renew before the deadline will receive a canvas tote bag as a thank-you gift.

explain.en: Only members who renew before the April 25 deadline get the tote bag, so later renewers will not. The letter does not mention a higher fee, and online renewal is offered.
explain.th: ของขวัญถุงผ้าให้เฉพาะสมาชิกที่ต่ออายุก่อนกำหนด (before the deadline) ดังนั้นคนที่ต่อหลังวันที่ 25 เมษายนจะไม่ได้ ส่วนค่าธรรมเนียมที่สูงขึ้นไม่มีระบุ และต่อออนไลน์ได้

docs.title: Memo: New expense reporting system
docs.body:
To: All Sales Staff
From: Ruth Delgado, Finance Department
Date: September 12
Subject: New expense reporting system

[1] Beginning October 1, all travel and meal expenses must be submitted through the new online system instead of on paper forms. [2] The system lets you photograph receipts with your phone and upload them immediately. [3] Reimbursements will be deposited within five business days. [4] Paper forms submitted after September 30 will not be processed.

Training sessions will be held in Room 204 on September 20 and September 24. To reserve a seat, please contact Mr. Okafor in Finance at extension 118.

questions.prompt: What is the memo mainly about?
choices: A change in how expenses are submitted
A new policy on business travel
The hiring of a Finance employee
A software problem in the Sales Department

evidence.quote: all travel and meal expenses must be submitted through the new online system instead of on paper forms

explain.en: The memo announces that expenses must be submitted online instead of on paper starting October 1. Travel is only one type of expense it mentions.
explain.th: บันทึกแจ้งว่าตั้งแต่ 1 ตุลาคม ต้องส่งค่าใช้จ่ายผ่านระบบออนไลน์แทนแบบฟอร์มกระดาษ (instead of on paper forms) จึงเป็นเรื่องการเปลี่ยนวิธีส่งค่าใช้จ่าย

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The uploaded image is stored automatically, so you no longer need to keep the paper copy."

evidence.quote: The system lets you photograph receipts with your phone and upload them immediately.

explain.en: The phrase 'the uploaded image' must follow the sentence about uploading receipts, which is just before position [3]. Later positions follow talk of reimbursements and paper forms, which breaks the link.
explain.th: ประโยค 'The uploaded image' ต้องตามหลังประโยคที่พูดถึงการถ่ายรูปและอัปโหลดใบเสร็จ ซึ่งอยู่ก่อนตำแหน่ง [3] พอดี ตำแหน่งอื่นไม่เชื่อมกับเนื้อหาก่อนหน้า

questions.prompt: How can an employee reserve a seat at a training session?
choices: By emailing Ms. Delgado
By contacting Mr. Okafor
By visiting Room 204
By using the online system

evidence.quote: To reserve a seat, please contact Mr. Okafor in Finance at extension 118.

explain.en: The memo says to contact Mr. Okafor. Room 204 is where the sessions take place, not where seats are reserved.
explain.th: บันทึกให้ติดต่อคุณ Okafor ฝ่ายการเงินเพื่อจองที่นั่ง (contact Mr. Okafor) ส่วนห้อง 204 เป็นสถานที่จัดอบรม ไม่ใช่ที่จอง

docs.title: Article: Riverside market adds a second day
docs.body:
RIVERSIDE (May 20) - Riverside Farmers Market will add a second weekly market day beginning in June, organizers announced on Monday. The market, which has operated every Saturday for twelve years, will now also open on Wednesday evenings from 4 to 8 P.M.

"Many of our customers work on weekends or travel out of town," said market manager Carla Singh. "An evening market gives them a chance to shop for fresh food after work." The Wednesday market will have about 30 vendors, fewer than the 65 who take part on Saturdays.

The expansion was made possible by a $20,000 grant from the Tri-County Food Council. Part of the money will be used to install lighting in the market plaza. Ms. Singh said that organizers hope to add live music to the Wednesday events by August.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
choices: The opening of a new farmers market
A plan to add a weekday market
A grant awarded for a food study
The retirement of a market manager

evidence.quote: Riverside Farmers Market will add a second weekly market day beginning in June

explain.en: The first sentence says the market will add a second weekly day, on Wednesday evenings. The grant is only how the expansion is paid for.
explain.th: ประโยคแรกบอกว่าตลาดจะเพิ่มวันขายที่สองในแต่ละสัปดาห์ (add a second weekly market day) เป็นเย็นวันพุธ เงินทุนเป็นเพียงที่มาของงบ ไม่ใช่ใจความหลัก

questions.prompt: What will part of the grant money be used for?
choices: Hiring more vendors
Paying for live music
Building a new market plaza
Installing lighting

evidence.quote: Part of the money will be used to install lighting in the market plaza.

explain.en: The article says part of the money will install lighting in the plaza. Live music is only something organizers hope to add later.
explain.th: ส่วนหนึ่งของเงินทุนจะใช้ติดตั้งไฟ (install lighting) ในลานตลาด ส่วนดนตรีสดเป็นแค่สิ่งที่ผู้จัดหวังจะเพิ่มในภายหลัง

questions.prompt: What is NOT stated about the Wednesday market?
choices: It will start in June.
It will take place in the evening.
It will have fewer vendors than the Saturday market.
It will feature live music from its first day.

evidence.quote: organizers hope to add live music to the Wednesday events by August

explain.en: Live music is only a hope for August, not a feature from the first day. The other three points are stated directly.
explain.th: ดนตรีสดเป็นเพียงสิ่งที่ผู้จัดหวังจะเพิ่มภายในเดือนสิงหาคม (hope to add ... by August) ไม่ได้มีตั้งแต่วันแรก ส่วนข้ออื่นระบุไว้ชัดเจน

docs.title: Ad: Corner Print Studio
docs.body:
CORNER PRINT STUDIO
Business printing made simple

Need brochures, banners, or business cards in a hurry? Corner Print Studio offers same-day printing on orders placed before 11 A.M. Our designers can also help you prepare your files at no additional charge.

GRAND OPENING SPECIAL (through March 31)

Visit us at 18 Mill Road, open Monday through Saturday from 8 A.M. to 6 P.M. Orders may also be placed online at any time. Bring this ad to receive a free sample pack of our premium paper.

questions.prompt: What service does Corner Print Studio provide at no additional charge?
choices: Same-day printing
Help preparing files
Delivery on every order
A second set of business cards

evidence.quote: Our designers can also help you prepare your files at no additional charge.

explain.en: Help preparing files is free. Same-day printing is offered for orders before 11 A.M., but nothing says it is free of charge.
explain.th: สตูดิโอช่วยเตรียมไฟล์ให้ฟรี (at no additional charge) ส่วนการพิมพ์ภายในวันเดียวมีเงื่อนไขเรื่องเวลา และไม่ได้บอกว่าฟรี

questions.prompt: What is NOT true about Corner Print Studio?
choices: It accepts orders online.
It is open six days a week.
It can print some orders the same day.
It delivers free on all orders.

evidence.quote: Free delivery within the city limits on orders over $75

explain.en: Free delivery applies only within the city limits and on orders over $75, so it is not free on all orders. The other statements match the ad.
explain.th: จัดส่งฟรีเฉพาะในเขตเมืองและเมื่อสั่งเกิน 75 ดอลลาร์ (orders over $75) ไม่ใช่ทุกออเดอร์ ส่วนข้ออื่นตรงกับโฆษณา

questions.prompt: What is suggested about an order placed at 2 P.M.?
choices: It will not qualify for same-day printing.
It will be printed for free.
It cannot be placed online.
It will receive the banner discount.

evidence.quote: same-day printing on orders placed before 11 A.M.

explain.en: Same-day printing applies only to orders placed before 11 A.M., so a 2 P.M. order will not qualify. Online orders are accepted at any time.
explain.th: พิมพ์วันเดียวได้เฉพาะออเดอร์ที่สั่งก่อน 11 โมง (before 11 A.M.) ออเดอร์ตอนบ่ายสองจึงไม่เข้าเงื่อนไข ส่วนสั่งออนไลน์ได้ทุกเวลา

docs.title: Notice: Office recycling program
docs.body:
NOTICE TO ALL EMPLOYEES

Starting Monday, February 3, the Hanford office will begin a new recycling program. Blue bins for paper and plastic will be placed on each floor next to the copy machines, and the small desk-side trash cans will be removed. Employees are asked to bring any food waste to the kitchen on the first floor, where a compost container will be available.

To help everyone adjust, facilities staff will visit each department during the week of February 3 to answer questions. Employees who would like to suggest additional bin locations may do so by contacting Gina Foster in Facilities. We appreciate your cooperation in making our workplace more environmentally friendly.

questions.prompt: What is the notice mainly about?
choices: A renovation of the kitchen
The start of a recycling program
A new policy on office supplies
A reduction of cleaning staff

evidence.quote: the Hanford office will begin a new recycling program

explain.en: The notice announces a new recycling program and explains how it will work. The kitchen is mentioned only as the place for food waste.
explain.th: ประกาศแจ้งการเริ่มโครงการรีไซเคิลใหม่ (a new recycling program) และอธิบายวิธีการ ห้องครัวถูกกล่าวถึงเพียงเป็นที่ทิ้งเศษอาหาร

questions.prompt: The word "adjust" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
choices: correct
lower
adapt
count

evidence.quote: To help everyone adjust, facilities staff will visit each department

explain.en: Staff will visit departments to answer questions and help people adjust to the new system, meaning adapt to it. Nothing is being fixed, reduced or measured.
explain.th: เจ้าหน้าที่จะไปตอบคำถามเพื่อช่วยให้ทุกคนปรับตัว (adjust) กับระบบใหม่ คือทำความคุ้นเคยกับการเปลี่ยนแปลง ไม่ได้แก้ข้อผิดพลาดหรือลดต้นทุน

questions.prompt: What will employees most likely do after February 3?
choices: Pay for their own recycling bins
Take paper and plastic waste to a bin on their floor
Carry all trash to the first floor
Ask for approval before discarding paper

evidence.quote: Blue bins for paper and plastic will be placed on each floor next to the copy machines, and the small desk-side trash cans will be removed.

explain.en: Desk-side cans will be removed and blue bins placed on each floor, so people must walk to a shared bin. Only food waste goes to the first-floor kitchen.
explain.th: ถังที่โต๊ะจะถูกเก็บออกและมีถังสีน้ำเงินประจำแต่ละชั้น (on each floor) พนักงานจึงต้องเดินไปทิ้งกระดาษและพลาสติกที่ถังกลาง ส่วนเศษอาหารเท่านั้นที่ต้องนำไปครัวชั้นหนึ่ง

docs.title: Schedule: Warehouse safety workshops
docs.body:
Eastgate Logistics - Safety Workshop Schedule (October)

Tuesday, October 8
9:00-10:30 A.M. Forklift Basics (Trainer: R. Mendes) - Dock Office
1:00-2:00 P.M. Handling Hazardous Materials (Trainer: S. Patel) - Training Room

Thursday, October 10
9:00-10:00 A.M. Lifting and Back Safety (Trainer: S. Patel) - Training Room
11:00 A.M.-12:00 P.M. Emergency Exits and Fire Drills (Trainer: L. Grant) - Main Hall

Notes: Employees must attend at least three workshops by October 31. Forklift Basics is required for all dock staff. Hazardous Materials is limited to 15 participants; sign up with your supervisor. Workshops are held on company time, and attendance will be recorded.

questions.prompt: Who will lead the session on lifting and back safety?
choices: R. Mendes
S. Patel
L. Grant
A supervisor

evidence.quote: Lifting and Back Safety (Trainer: S. Patel)

explain.en: The schedule lists S. Patel as the trainer for Lifting and Back Safety. Supervisors are mentioned only for signing up.
explain.th: ตารางระบุว่า S. Patel เป็นผู้สอนหัวข้อ Lifting and Back Safety ส่วนหัวหน้างานถูกกล่าวถึงเรื่องการลงชื่อเท่านั้น

questions.prompt: What is NOT indicated about the workshops?
choices: Dock staff must take Forklift Basics.
Attendance will be recorded.
One workshop has a limit on participants.
All workshops take place in the Training Room.

evidence.quote: Emergency Exits and Fire Drills (Trainer: L. Grant) - Main Hall

explain.en: Forklift Basics is in the Dock Office and the fire drills session is in the Main Hall, so not all workshops are in the Training Room. The other three points are in the notes.
explain.th: Forklift Basics จัดที่ Dock Office และ Emergency Exits ที่ Main Hall จึงไม่ใช่ทุกหัวข้อที่จัดใน Training Room ส่วนข้ออื่นระบุไว้ในหมายเหตุ

questions.prompt: What is implied about an employee who attends only two workshops?
choices: The employee must repeat Forklift Basics.
The employee will lose pay.
The employee will not meet the October requirement.
The employee will be excluded from fire drills.

evidence.quote: Employees must attend at least three workshops by October 31.

explain.en: Everyone must attend at least three workshops by October 31, so someone who attends only two falls short. Nothing is said about lost pay or repeating a course.
explain.th: พนักงานต้องเข้าอย่างน้อยสามหัวข้อภายใน 31 ตุลาคม (at least three workshops) ถ้าเข้าแค่สองจึงไม่ครบตามข้อกำหนด ส่วนการหักเงินหรือต้องเรียนซ้ำไม่มีระบุ

docs.title: Form: Equipment loan request
docs.body:
Lakeview Community Center - Equipment Loan Request

Name: Teresa Wong
Organization: Lakeview Youth Soccer League
Phone: 555-0142
Email: twong@lakeviewsoccer.example

Items requested: 2 portable goal sets; 1 scoreboard
Pickup date: Friday, August 16, between 4 and 6 P.M.
Return date: Monday, August 19, by 10 A.M.

Purpose of loan: Weekend tournament for players under age 12

Office use only:
Status: Approved with changes
Staff comment: The scoreboard is already reserved for the weekend of August 17. A smaller portable scoreboard is available instead. A $50 refundable deposit is required at pickup for all loans.
Processed by: Hugo Reyes, August 9

questions.prompt: Why was the request approved with changes?
choices: Ms. Wong asked for too many goal sets.
The scoreboard is unavailable that weekend.
The return date is a holiday.
The league has not paid a deposit.

evidence.quote: The scoreboard is already reserved for the weekend of August 17.

explain.en: The staff comment says the scoreboard is already reserved that weekend and offers a smaller one. The deposit is due at pickup, so it is not a reason for the change.
explain.th: ความเห็นเจ้าหน้าที่ระบุว่าป้ายคะแนนถูกจองไว้แล้วในสุดสัปดาห์นั้น จึงเสนอรุ่นเล็กแทน ส่วนเงินมัดจำจ่ายตอนรับของ ไม่ใช่เหตุผลของการแก้ไข

questions.prompt: The word "reserved" in the staff comment is closest in meaning to
choices: canceled
approved
booked
repaired

evidence.quote: The scoreboard is already reserved for the weekend of August 17.

explain.en: Something that is already reserved has been booked by someone else, which is why a smaller scoreboard is offered. It has not been canceled or repaired.
explain.th: already reserved หมายถึงมีคนจองไว้แล้ว (booked) จึงต้องเสนอป้ายคะแนนอันเล็กแทน ไม่ได้ถูกยกเลิกหรือซ่อม

questions.prompt: What will Ms. Wong most likely do when she picks up the equipment?
choices: Return the goals
Submit a new form
Register players
Pay a refundable deposit

evidence.quote: A $50 refundable deposit is required at pickup for all loans.

explain.en: A $50 refundable deposit is required at pickup for all loans, so she will pay it. Returning the equipment happens on August 19.
explain.th: ต้องจ่ายเงินมัดจำคืนได้ 50 ดอลลาร์ตอนรับของ (required at pickup) สำหรับทุกการยืม คุณ Wong จึงจะจ่ายเงินมัดจำ ส่วนการคืนของเป็นวันที่ 19 สิงหาคม
